title: Prompt-Pay Loyalty Points for Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Accounts
content:
**Guidance.** Loyalty points are added to the prompt-pay rate of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account according to two conditions:

- **A.** the coverage record has been held at least 60 whole calendar months since its effective date; and
- **B.** the account shows at least 4 patient-payment entries posted fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date.

Both conditions met add 1 point; exactly one of them met adds 0.5 points; neither met adds none.

## Truth table

| A: held at least 60 months | B: at least 4 payment entries in the last 12 months | Points |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 1 |
| yes | no | 0.5 |
| no | yes | 0.5 |
| no | no | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Held 60 whole months, 4 entries in the window: both met, 1 point.
- Held 59 whole months, 4 entries: only B met, 0.5 points.
- Held 72 months, 3 entries: only A met, 0.5 points.
- An entry posted 12 whole months before the handling date is outside the window and does not count toward B.

The points enlarge the prompt-pay rate itself, applied once to the charge.
